'''Skinflayer''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Skinflayers had two legs, large arms with four claws on each hand, a short tail, spikes on their heads and a mouth full of sharp teeth. Skinflayers could be found in [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] environments of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] and [[Taral V]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> A Skinflayer named [[Fleshripper]] was owned by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]],<ref name="TOR:HC">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|House Cleaning|Hutta}}</ref> while another Skinflayer named [[Mister Ripper]] was a pet of [[Thades Gorkultok]], a [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] in the [[Arena Grand]] of [[Zakuul]].<ref name="KOTFE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Skinflayers were created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. They appear as enemies during "Taral V" flashpoint and can also be found on Belsavis, most prominently in [[Section X]].
